out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the LACTIC ACID solution was measured at 5.86. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of LACTIC ACID solution at 2.11 TO 4.30 MILILITRES. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the new dish machine with a concentration of 0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CFM will use main dish machine to wasrinse and sanitized glasses until the new dish machine is repair BURTON'S GRILL & BAR (Inspection Date: 04/21/2026) Page 2 of 3
